facts.fact: 登船日：Bristol 悬崖天然港+巨舢板；Seeker=海上宫殿（Icarus 的评价准确）；马匹顺序上船（种马先过板给 Jaco/Speckle 做示范）；Lumi 看管 Argus 远离悬崖
facts.anchor: The Seeker is a floating palace, and even with its sails gathered tight

facts.fact: Alden 告别：cottage 相赠（原给 Lumi 现给他——「I can only lose one best friend at a time, and I'd rather keep the hound with the beard」）+「Take care of them all, General Nash.」（唯一一次称衔）+「You're right—we are both like him」
facts.anchor: Take care of them all, General Nash.”

facts.fact: Alden 的权力直觉：「People move before he orders it. Nobody challenges him. I mean, the man doesn't even give direct orders…they shift out of Draven's way before he's even near them. I recognize power when I see it.」——他的 Mnesic 记忆+权力嗅探
facts.anchor: People move before he orders it. Nobody challenges him.

facts.fact: 藏书相赠：整箱皮革烫金书送 Alden——「It's the friend you have who suggested I give them to you.」——Alden 眼睛全白（狂喜）；「Can I be your best friend instead, Draven?」玩笑
facts.anchor: This is every bit of written knowledge I have aboard my ship, Alden.”

facts.fact: 最后的敬礼：两人捶胸+一秒拥抱——「I release my best friend so I can leave him forever」；century 列队敬礼送行（「more importantly, they deserve every bit of glory for shaping me」）
facts.anchor: With a straight back, tears blinding my vision, I hit my chest, and Alden hits his.

facts.fact: 终章核弹：Orris 一句「Where to, my prince?」——Draven=Cadmar 王储（「Crown Prince, to be exact」）——「Everything makes sense—everything is now falling into place」；Alden 的直觉被证实但已无法告诉他
facts.anchor: “I am,” he admits without hesitance. “Crown Prince, to be exact.”

facts.fact: 终句：她的测试「Does an exiled warrior and the princess of a wicked throne still earn your love?」——他「My love for you is not something that has to be earned…Then I would take my exiled wicked princess to Cadmar and crown her queen.」
facts.anchor: Then I would take my exiled wicked princess to Cadmar and crown her queen.”
